spec_quote: Start/stop is a 1 bit control signal that controls if the stopwatch is running or paused.
fix: Only advance count/pulse when start == 1; hold them when paused so the timebase pauses with the stopwatch.

spec_quote: The clock divider within the module uses this parameter to generate a one-second pulse (`one_sec_pulse`).
fix: Increment seconds on the same edge the divider wraps (e.g., use n_pulse or count == 3) rather than the previous cycle's pulse.
